review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for C. The complete PRD fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input, explicitly not a human Decision, so an empty human-decision input is consistent with expectedReadiness=ready. An unresolved material DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions before later prerequisites; C does not waive that rule. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, exact writable scopes, and required evidence stages agree across the specification and Gold. The supplied source supports the owner split: HTTPError formatting, option declarations/normalization, and kyOptionKeys require implementation coverage; existing generic merge, forwarding, and hook/type consumers can remain inspection-only. Build configuration establishes distribution declarations as generated outputs, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for separate compile-time verification. Implementation and dependent independent verification must each cover all required acceptance criteria. The allowed implementer and verifier have the supplied active trusted capability claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer, and verifier-only testing.verification; eligibility need not be inferred from personas or pending legacy claims. Independent review configuration is supplied. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the documented manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence explain the differing source fingerprints. The original preparation flags are distinct from the frozen preview and expected planning readiness, not evidence of execution or release approval. This review uses only supplied evidence, with no candidate outputs, tool execution, independent digest recomputation, or new human attestation.
